reports.title: Cordell Hull fishing report
reports.text: Bass- Fishing is decent. The grass bite should be arriving. The reservoir level has dropped a few inches and is projected to drop a foot by this weekend. In response, the grass tops are starting to reappear and reform in intermediate depths. On top of that, there is a big presence of Threadfin shad schooled in and around the grass patches on the main river and in the creek arms. Because of this, there are a lot of bass, and some quality sized bass, in and around the grass. The biggest bass are out in front of the matted grass, use topwater like spooks and small buzzbaits. As the nights cool and water temperatures drop, you can catch more bass on frogs or punching the thick, matted…
reports.by: Will Schibig, Region III Creel Clerk

reports.title: Watts Bar Reservoir fishing report
reports.text: Bass: Many anglers targeting any Black Bass species are finding better success in the lacustrine (Middle and Lower) areas of the reservoir. Anglers are finding more success in earlier morning hours using Texas rig, wacky rig, and ned rigs up shallow around woody debris or rocky structure. Once the sun gets high, many anglers convert to offshore fishing. Areas like offshore flats/humps and channel ledges are mostly targeted.
reports.by: Nathan Rogers, Region III Creel Clerk
